title: Recovered Tim Dooley Formalisms — Wave 002
epistemic_rule: Recovered project language is distinguished from later mathematical formalization and from established external science. Where an exact historical formula is missing, the archive records the attested concept without fabricating an equation.

recovered.name: Fibonacci research recursion
recovered.project_use: Research waves expand recursively; each completed structure becomes material for the next structure. The project explicitly rejects treating Fibonacci as mystical proof.

recovered.name: Research frontier priority score
recovered.equation: priority = breadth × importance × incompleteness × connectivity × source_availability × novelty
recovered.project_use: Select the strongest unfinished research frontier rather than expanding arbitrarily. This is a heuristic scoring rule, not a statistically calibrated estimator.

recovered.name: Recursive expansion operator
recovered.pseudocode: EXPAND(X): locate X → read record → find parents/children → aliases/neighbours → authoritative sources → create missing eyes → typed relations → comparisons → contradictions → unknowns → update affected nodes → recalculate frontier → recurse
recovered.project_use: Formalizes the archive's recursive research method.

recovered.name: Moving-frame rule
recovered.statement: the frame moves; the library does not
recovered.mathematical_reading: A global graph G remains fixed while a navigation projection or rooted view Π_r(G) changes with chosen center r.
recovered.status: archive formalization of explicit project rule

recovered.name: Recursive cosmological frame
recovered.cycle: Source → Father → Father's House → Heaven → Throne of North → Ladder → Door → Son → Axis → Tree of Life → Plane → Roots → Potato → Source
recovered.status: recursive symbolic frame, not literal physical cosmology

recovered.name: Transformation operators

operators.Eye: local aperture from which a direction becomes possible
operators.Root: draws from past/soil and creates support
operators.Sprout: turns stored potential into directional emergence
operators.Compost: breaks failed/dead forms into reusable substrate
operators.Kneel: collapses resistance/ego into a post-collapse state
operators.Vesica: overlap where two domains generate a third possibility
operators.Merkaba: dynamic counter-rotation/alignment of opposites around a center
operators.Garden: environmental/cultivation operator that changes what can grow

recovered.formalization_note: These can be modeled as maps or operators on a state space, but the map definitions were not originally given as numerical functions.
